name: Claude Code
description: Companion for your remote Claude Code sessions: connect over SSH to a machine running Claude Code and work through its official structured interface — read the streamed transcript on calm e-paper, see tool actions, and send follow-up prompts with the Type Folio or the on-screen keyboard. Phase 1 requires a config file (~/.config/reboard/claude.conf with host= and directory=) and SSH key authentication to the remote host.
